newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-DAEHLIE HANDS NORWAY FIRST GOLD IN 10-KM RACE.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-DAEHLIE HANDS NORWAY FIRST GOLD IN 10-KM RACE.

text.p: Bjorn Daehlie handed Norway their first gold medal at this year's Nordic skiing world championships by winning the 10-km, classical-style cross-country race on Monday.
Olympic champion Daehlie led at all intermediate checkpoints to clock a winning time of 23 minutes 41.80 seconds, according to provisional results.
Russia's Alexei Prokurorov, the winner of Friday's 30-km freestyle race, was second, 27.9 seconds slower, while Mika Myllilae of Finland was third a further 4.5 seconds back.
Monday's race was the first part of a pursuit event which will end on Tuesday with the 15-km freestyle race.
